{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
# Confirm the presence of thousands separators
print("Rows with commas in revenue:", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).sum())
# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'status', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean']])"}
